# Recognition fixture

`arbutus-unedo.jpg` is iNaturalist photo 153537628, used to check the real offline model pipeline. It is not a photo reference used by the classifier.

Source: https://inaturalist-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/photos/153537628/medium.jpeg

License: [CC BY-NC](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Retain this credit when sharing the fixture.

This fixture proves the integration for one image, not field accuracy or absence from the model training data.
